retrieval_note: Identifiers and titles verified against ISO online browsing platform (https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/) on 2026-10-31. Standards are copyrighted; only non-copyrighted metadata is stored.
disclaimer: This registry stores only publicly available metadata (identifiers, titles, scope summaries in the registry author's own words). No copyrighted standard text is reproduced. Numeric test parameters (drop heights, loads, vibration profiles, conditioning ranges, acceptance criteria) are NOT hardcoded and must be configured by users who hold the licensed standard.

standards.title: Packaging and the environment — Optimization of the packaging system
standards.scope_summary: Specifies requirements and a procedure for assessing that the weight or volume of packaging material is minimized consistent with the packaging's required functions. Covers system-level optimization rather than individual package optimization. Note: replacing one material with another is not by itself optimization under this standard; optimization may require adding packaging to prevent loss of goods.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Core standard for NxtPak AI's material reduction and waste-reduction goal. PROGRAMMATIC checks on volume utilization and material savings directly support an ISO 18602-style assessment; final assessment requires HUMAN_REVIEW.

programmatic_sub_checks.description: Volume utilization: product volume / packaging internal volume

standards.notes_and_limitations: Full assessment procedure is in ISO 18601. A software PASS on sub-checks is not proof of ISO 18602 conformance. No El Araby company-specific thresholds loaded.

standards.title: Packaging and the environment — General requirements for the use of ISO standards in the field of packaging and the environment
standards.scope_summary: Defines the general requirements and framework for applying the ISO 18600 series (packaging and environment standards), including terminology, common requirements, and the procedure for using them together.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Provides the overarching framework for applying ISO 18602. Referenced in reports to indicate the assessment framework used.
standards.notes_and_limitations: Framework standard; no standalone programmatic checks. Assessment requires human review by a qualified engineer.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages — General rules for the compilation of performance test schedules
standards.scope_summary: Provides general rules and guidance for selecting and sequencing physical performance tests to form a test schedule appropriate for a specific transport package and distribution environment. Does not itself prescribe specific test severities.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Informs the test planning context shown on the Standards page. Physical test scheduling decisions require HUMAN_REVIEW.
standards.notes_and_limitations: Test schedule compilation requires a qualified packaging engineer. No programmatic check is possible.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages and unit loads — Conditioning for testing
standards.scope_summary: Specifies the standard atmospheric conditions (temperature and humidity) and the conditioning periods for transport packages and unit loads before and during testing. Conditioning ensures reproducible test results.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Pre-test conditioning is required before any physical test (drop, compression, vibration, etc.). NOT_VERIFIABLE by software.
standards.notes_and_limitations: Requires controlled laboratory environment. Software cannot verify conditioning compliance. Parameters must be configured by the user holding the licensed standard.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages — Identification of parts when testing
standards.scope_summary: Defines the naming convention for identifying the faces, edges, and corners of a rectangular transport package (e.g., face 1, 2, 3; edges; corners) so that test results can be unambiguously recorded and reported.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Ensures consistent face/edge/corner identification in test reports. Applied automatically by NxtPak in 3D viewer face labeling (faces 1–6, edges, corners as per this standard).

programmatic_sub_checks.description: Assign ISO 2206 face, edge, and corner identifiers to the generated packaging geometry
programmatic_sub_checks.formula: Deterministic assignment from box L×W×H geometry

standards.notes_and_limitations: Identification is PROGRAMMATIC for geometry labeling. Physical test execution and recording is PHYSICAL_TEST.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages — Vertical impact test by dropping
standards.scope_summary: Specifies the method for carrying out vertical impact (drop) tests on complete filled transport packages. Tests the ability of packaging to withstand drops during handling.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Drop resistance is a key protection requirement. Test requires physical execution; drop height parameters must be configured by the user.
standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test only. Software cannot simulate or verify drop test results. Drop height must not be hardcoded — must be user-configured from the licensed standard or approved test specification.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages and unit loads — Horizontal impact tests
standards.scope_summary: Specifies methods for horizontal impact testing (incline impact and flat car shunting) of transport packages and unit loads to evaluate their ability to withstand horizontal impacts during transport.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Horizontal impact testing is required for packages transported by rail or road. Physical test only.

required_parameters.name: impact_velocity_m_s
required_parameters.description: Impact velocity for horizontal impact test

required_parameters.name: test_method
required_parameters.description: Incline impact or flat car shunting

standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test only. Parameters must be user-configured.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages — Toppling test
standards.scope_summary: Specifies the method for carrying out a toppling test on complete filled transport packages to evaluate their ability to withstand the dynamic loading resulting from toppling (tipping over).
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Toppling resistance is relevant for tall packages (e.g., stand fan packaging). Physical test only.

required_parameters.name: toppling_angle_deg
required_parameters.description: Angle from which the package is toppled

standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test only. Particularly relevant for tall/narrow packages.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages and unit loads — Stacking tests using a static load
standards.scope_summary: Specifies the method for applying a static compressive load to a transport package or unit load to evaluate its ability to withstand stacking during storage and transport.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Stacking strength is critical for warehouse storage. The static load parameters must be user-configured.

required_parameters.name: static_load_kg
required_parameters.description: Static load applied to the top surface

standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test only. Load values must not be hardcoded.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages — Compression and stacking tests using a compression tester
standards.scope_summary: Specifies methods for compression testing of transport packages using a compression testing machine. Covers both constant load and constant rate of compression methods.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Compression test measures carton board crush resistance. Physical test using specialized equipment.

required_parameters.name: compression_rate_mm_min
required_parameters.description: Rate of compression (if constant rate method)

standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test requiring compression testing machine. Software cannot simulate this.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages and unit loads — Vibration tests at fixed low frequency
standards.scope_summary: Specifies methods for testing transport packages using sinusoidal vibration at a fixed low frequency to evaluate the ability of the package and its contents to withstand low-frequency vibration encountered during transport.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Vibration testing is relevant for fragile products. Physical test requiring vibration table equipment.
standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test requiring vibration test equipment. Software cannot simulate.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages and unit loads — Sinusoidal vibration tests using a variable frequency
standards.scope_summary: Specifies methods for sinusoidal vibration testing with a swept (variable) frequency range to simulate vibration hazards encountered during transport and identify resonant frequencies of the package system.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Swept-frequency vibration testing identifies resonance issues. Physical test only.
standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test requiring vibration table with sweep capability.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages and unit loads — Vertical random vibration test
standards.scope_summary: Specifies a method for testing packages using broadband random vibration in the vertical axis to simulate the vibration environment encountered during road, rail, and air transport.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Random vibration testing is the most realistic vibration simulation. Physical test only.

required_parameters.name: psd_profile
required_parameters.description: Power spectral density profile (must be user-configured from licensed standard)

standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test requiring random vibration test equipment and licensed PSD profile data.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages — Water-spray test
standards.scope_summary: Specifies a method for testing the resistance of transport packages to water sprayed from above, simulating exposure to rain or other water hazards during transport.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: Water resistance is relevant for products stored outdoors or in humid environments. Physical test only.
standards.notes_and_limitations: Physical test requiring spray test equipment.

standards.title: Packaging — Complete, filled transport packages and unit loads — Unit load dimensions
standards.scope_summary: Specifies the preferred dimensions for unit loads to optimize storage, handling, and transport efficiency on pallets and in transport vehicles. Defines a series of module-based dimensions.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: PROGRAMMATIC check: can verify whether proposed packaging dimensions fit within ISO 3676 unit-load modules when user provides the target module dimensions.

programmatic_sub_checks.description: Check whether packaging footprint and height are compatible with specified unit load dimensions
programmatic_sub_checks.formula: pkg_L <= unit_load_L AND pkg_W <= unit_load_W AND pkg_H <= unit_load_H

standards.notes_and_limitations: Check is NOT_CONFIGURED until user provides target unit load dimensions. Preferred modular dimensions from the standard must be entered by a user holding the licensed standard.

standards.title: Packaging — Dimensions of rigid rectangular packages
standards.scope_summary: Specifies the preferred dimensions for rigid rectangular packages to ensure compatibility with unit loads, storage systems, and handling equipment. Promotes a modular system of package dimensions.
standards.relevance_to_nxtpak: PROGRAMMATIC check: can verify whether proposed packaging dimensions conform to configured modular dimension series when user provides the module base.

programmatic_sub_checks.description: Check whether packaging dimensions conform to the specified modular dimension grid
programmatic_sub_checks.formula: pkg_L % module_L == 0 AND pkg_W % module_W == 0 (or fits within tolerance)

standards.notes_and_limitations: Check is NOT_CONFIGURED until user provides modular dimension parameters. Title verified; confirm full title against latest catalog.
